Chapter 7063: Outrageous Matters

Chapter 7063: Outrageous Matters

All immortals became curious and wanted to gossip about this matter.

“What kind of existence can take the high heaven’s wrath and gestate another being?” An immortal asked.

“Must be a celestial immortal?” A golden immortal responded.

“Perhaps strength is not the crux of the issue but rather, the form.” A primordial immortal added.

The high heaven’s wrath, or the tribulations, could be confronted or avoided to a certain extent. However, using them in this manner was unimaginable.

“A work of art stemming from a bold experiment, not cursed either.” Li Qiye said.

“And?” The dragon shouted.

“I’m just letting you know that the high heaven’s wrath is useless before me.” Li Qiye strengthened his grip and crushed the tribulation.

The bloody mist, or the source of the dragon, dispersed immediately and returned to the ocean.

“Splash!” Dragongrasp appeared in the same lying position, looking as if he were drinking the seawater.

“I told you, I can’t be killed.” He uttered coldly.

“All of us as well.” Zhao Dachui laughed.

“I’ve seen many strange things in life, today tops them all.” One spectator commented.

The dragon’s source had been crushed earlier. However, he was still revived.

“Can’t be killed? You all are already dead anyway.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Is that true?” Someone wondered.

“What kind of state are they in?” Another asked.

“Only true immortals can be unkillable.” A third cultivator spoke.

“Don’t worry, you will join us soon enough.” Heaven’s Demise said.

Others stared at the fallen ones as if their location was hell itself.

“Don’t you realize all I need to do is destroy this place and that will be the end of you? If you think you’re alive, that’s wrong. Your life force is not your own.” Li Qiye said.

“We are alive and unkillable.” Heaven’s Slayer disagreed.

“I see, you all refuse to think that you’re mere puppets.” Li Qiye smiled: “Then leave this ocean of tribulations, that will be the true test of whether you’re alive or not.”

“Puppets.” Spectators tried again with their heavenly gaze to no avail. Alas, they were too weak to see through the celestial immortals.

However, they could still scan the weaker ones and overlords.

“A different life force is attached to them.” A golden immortal said after hearing Li Qiye’s reminder.

They saw life forces earlier and assumed these beings were alive. Upon closer inspection, the corpses and their life forces were separate.

“Still maintaining their old cultivation, it’s illogical.” Someone said.

“So many outrageous matters seen today.” A primordial immortal murmured.
